name: Car Parking Sensor
blurb: The full project. Measures distance, shows it on the screen, and beeps faster as you get closer. This is the one that talks to this website.
lede: This little machine measures how far away something is and beeps faster as you get closer — like the parking sensor in a car. Follow the four steps and it will be working in a few minutes.
try: Wave your hand in front of the distance sensor and watch the number change.

components.label: Distance sensor
components.what: Sends out a click and times the echo

components.label: LED light
components.what: Lights up when something is close

components.label: Buzzer
components.what: Beeps faster the closer you get
